name: bang
about: 40 houses in 4 hamlets. At 20:05 everyone within 700 m of the school hears a bang and posts within 30 seconds, on top of normal chatter.
because: Flooded heartbeats (every node, every 5 s, to every node) plus the burst saturate a 40-house mesh; repair then cannot keep up. With 30 s heartbeats the same scenario passes. Decision pending: one-hop heartbeats (village-sim findings, 2026-10-15).
